name: PRS-CS
model_likelihood: Standardized additive Gaussian phenotype model y=Z beta+epsilon; independent epsilon ~ N(0,sigma2 I); Jeffreys residual variance prior.
prior: Independent gamma-gamma local scales; Gaussian effects with variance (sigma2/N) phi psi_j; a=1, b=1/2 (Strawderman-Berger). Global phi chosen by validation.
inference_algorithm: Gibbs sampler with multivariate Gaussian effect updates within LD blocks and analytic full conditional updates for scales.
estimand: Posterior mean SNP effect sizes used as additive PRS weights.
data_input: GWAS marginal least-squares effects, GWAS sample size and external blockwise LD; standardized model also accepts individual-level data.
tunable_settings: a=1; b=1/2; rho=1 minimum regularization; LD partition (1703 blocks in study); MCMC length and burn-in (1000/500 in simulations, 10000/5000 in application); validation grid sqrt(phi) in {0.0001,0.001,0.01,0.1,1}
